blocks.text: Dekha gaya hai ke 82 se zyada atomic number wale nuclei qudrati taur par na-paidar hote hain; yeh khud-ba-khud radiations kharij karte hain. Aise nuclei radioactive kehlate hain, aur radiation ka ikhraaj qudrati radioactivity (natural radioactivity) kehlata hai. Radiations teen qism ki hain: alpha particles, beta particles aur gamma rays. Na-paidar isotopes laboratory mein nuclear reactions se masnoowi taur par bhi banaye ja sakte hain, jab paidar element ko neutrons, protons, alpha particles ya gamma rays jaise zyada energy ke zarron se mara jaye aur woh na-paidar ho kar radiation kharij kare. Ise masnoowi (artificial) radioactivity kehte hain, aur radioactive isotopes radioisotopes ya radionuclides kehlate hain.

Alpha particles, beta particles aur gamma rays electric field se guzarte hue mukhtalif rawayya dikhate hain (Fig. 12.4). Alpha particles manfi plate ki taraf murte hain, jo un ke musbat charge ka saboot hai; yeh tez speed, aam taur par light ki speed ke chand feesad, se nikalte hain magar apne bare mass ki wajah se hawa mein sirf chand centimetre chal pate hain. Beta particles musbat plate ki taraf murte hain, jo un ke manfi charge ka saboot hai; un ka murna alpha se zyada hai, jo sabit karta hai ke woh halke hain. Beta particles tez chalte electrons hain jin ki speed light ki speed ke 0.9995 tak hoti hai. Gamma rays electric field se be-mude guzarti hain, yaani un par charge nahi; yeh photons wali electromagnetic radiation hain, light ki speed se chalti hain, aur un ki penetrating power sab se zyada magar ionizing power sab se kam hai. Nucleus se alpha, beta aur gamma kharij hone ke amal alpha decay, beta decay aur gamma decay kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Radioactive maadda lead ke block mein ek khaane (cavity) ke sire par rakha hai. Is ki radiation ek shua (beam) ban kar nikalti hai aur do charged plates ke darmiyan se guzarti hai, oopar + aur neeche -. Plates ke baad beam teen hisson mein bant jati hai: beta rays + plate ki taraf zyada murti hain, gamma rays seedhi jati hain aur alpha rays - plate ki taraf thora murti hain; teeno photographic plate tak pohanchti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: Teen radioactive radiations, alpha, beta aur gamma (kitab ki Figure 12.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: lead block, radioactive substance, electrically charged plates, photographic plate, beta rays, gamma rays aur alpha rays. Beta ka rasta naranji, gamma ka jamni aur alpha ka hara hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Lead ka block radiation ko har taraf se rokta hai, is liye radiation sirf khaane ke munh se ek seedhi beam ban kar nikalti hai. Charged plates ke darmiyan beta particles manfi (negative) hone ki wajah se + plate ki taraf murte hain, alpha particles musbat (positive) hone ki wajah se - plate ki taraf murte hain, aur gamma rays par koi charge nahi, is liye woh seedhi jati hain. Beta ka mor (deflection) alpha se kahin zyada hai kyun ke beta (electron) bohat halka hai aur alpha bhaari. Photographic plate par teen alag nishan is baat ka saboot hain ke radiation teen qism ki hai.

Agar nucleus mein neutrons ke muqable protons zyada hon to electrostatic dafa strong nuclear kashish se zyada ho jati hai, nucleus na-paidar ho jata hai aur alpha particles kharij karta hai. Alpha particle helium ka nucleus hai, do protons aur do neutrons, to alpha decay mein nucleus do protons aur do neutrons khota hai: atomic number Z do aur mass number A chaar kam hota hai. Aam taur par: parent X (A, Z) -> daughter Y (A - 4, Z - 2) + helium-4 (A = 4, Z = 2) ... (12.2). Alpha decay mein nucleons ki tadaad (A) aur electric charge baqi rehte hain. Maslan radium-226 alpha particle kharij kar ke radon-222 mein badalta hai: radium-226 (Z = 88) -> radon-222 (Z = 86) + helium-4 ... (12.3).

blocks.alt: Parent nucleus radium-226 (A = 226, Z = 88) nucleons ke guchhe ki shakal mein hai. Is se ek dashed teer chhote alpha particle, helium-4 (A = 4, Z = 2), tak jata hai aur doosra dashed teer neeche daughter nucleus radon-222 (A = 222, Z = 86) tak.
blocks.caption: Radium-226 ka alpha decay: parent nucleus, alpha particle aur daughter nucleus radon-222 (kitab mein Equation 12.3 ke saath bane be-unwan khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Radium-226 ka nucleus apne andar se 2 protons aur 2 neutrons ka ek guchha, yaani alpha particle (helium-4), bahar phenkta hai. Peeche jo nucleus bachta hai woh radon-222 hai: mass number 226 - 4 = 222 aur atomic number 88 - 2 = 86. Dono teeron ke numbers jor kar dekhein: 222 + 4 = 226 aur 86 + 2 = 88, yaani nucleons ki tadaad aur charge dono baqi (conserve) rehte hain.

blocks.title: Transmutation aur Q-value
blocks.text: Ek element ka doosre mein badalna, jaise radium ka radon mein, transmutation kehlata hai. Parent nucleus ka mass daughter nucleus aur alpha particle ke kul mass se zyada paya jata hai, to decay ke hasil ki kul mass-energy (E = mc^2) asal nuclide se kam hai; mass-energy ka yeh farq disintegration energy Q, ya decay ki Q-value, kehlata hai.

Beta decay ki do qismein hain, beta-minus aur beta-plus. (i) Beta-minus decay: kuch nuclides mein neutron aur proton ki nisbat (N/P) bohat zyada hoti hai. Beta particles madari (orbital) electrons nahi; yeh ikhraaj ke lamhe nucleus ke andar bante hain: ek neutron proton aur electron mein, aur saath antineutrino, neutrino ka antiparticle (alamat nu-bar), mein badal jata hai: n -> p + e- + nu-bar. Charge baqi rakhne ke liye neutron ke proton banne ke saath electron, yaani beta particle, nikalta hai, jo madari electron se na-qabil-e-tameez hai. Neutrino aur antineutrino par charge sifar aur mass bohat kam hai, to inhein dekhna bohat mushkil hai. Koi nucleon nahi khota, to mass number A wahi rehta hai jabke atomic number Z ek barh jata hai: X (A, Z) -> Y (A, Z + 1) + e- + nu-bar. Maslan thorium ka na-paidar isotope beta ikhraaj se protactinium-234 (Z = 91) mein badalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke 'nucleons ki kul tadaad A wahi rehti hai magar mass number Z badalta hai'. Yahan lafz ghalat hai: A mass number hai aur Z atomic number. Beta-minus decay mein mass number A wahi rehta hai aur atomic number Z ek barh jata hai.

(ii) Beta-plus decay: jin nuclides mein neutron aur proton ki nisbat paidari ke liye bohat kam ho, woh electron ki bajaye positron kharij kar ke decay hote hain. Positron ka mass electron jitna magar charge musbat hai; yeh electron ka antiparticle hai. Nucleus mein proton neutron aur positron mein, aur saath neutrino mein, badal jata hai: X (A, Z) -> Y (A, Z - 1) + e+ + nu. Misal neon-19 ka positron aur neutrino kharij kar ke fluorine-19 banna hai. Neutrino sab se pehle Wolfgang Pauli ne 1930 mein beta decay mein energy ki baqa qaim rakhne ke liye tajweez kiya; 1953 mein F. Reines aur C. L. Cowan ne ise taqatwar nuclear reactor mein pakra, aur Reines ko 1995 mein Nobel Prize mila (For Your Information).
Alpha aur beta particles ki energy

Kisi khaas radionuclide ke alpha aur beta decay dono mein energy ki ek hi miqdar azaad hoti hai. Kisi radionuclide ke alpha decay mein har nikalne wale alpha particle ki kinetic energy ek jaisi aur waazeh hoti hai: alpha particles ki tadaad ko kinetic energy ke muqable plot karne par alag nokdar lakeerein (spikes) aati hain (Fig. 12.5), jo dikhati hain ke alpha particles ki energies alag alag (discrete) hain. Beta ikhraaj mein, magar, energy beta particle aur antineutrino mein mukhtalif nisbaton mein bant-ti hai; electron (ya positron) aur antineutrino (ya neutrino) ki energies ka majmooa har baar ek rehta hai. Yun beta decay mein electron ya positron ki energy sifar se zyada se zyada qeemat tak kuch bhi ho sakti hai: graph musalsal kham hai (Fig. 12.6), jo dikhata hai ke beta particles ki energies ki musalsal range hai. Momentum aur energy ki baqa ka usool alpha aur beta dono ikhraaj mein lagu hai.

blocks.alt: Alpha particles ki tadaad (N) aur kinetic energy (eV) ka graph. Kham (curve) ki bajaye is mein mukhtalif oonchai ki chaar alag amoodi lakeerein (spikes) khaas energies par hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: Alpha particles ki alag alag (discrete) energy qeematein (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Beta particles ki tadaad (N) aur kinetic energy (eV) ka graph. Ek hamwar musalsal kham amoodi mehwar (axis) par thora oopar se shuru hota hai, kam energy par chouti (peak) tak jata hai, phir girta hua sab se zyada energy par sifar tak pohanch jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Beta particles ka musalsal (continuous) spectrum (kitab ki Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono graphs ka muqabla karein. Figure 12.5 mein sirf chand khaas energies par alag lakeerein hain: alpha particles tay-shuda (discrete) energies ke saath nikalte hain, aur beech ki energies par koi alpha particle nahi milta. Figure 12.6 mein kham sifar se zyada se zyada energy tak bina toote chalta hai: beta decay mein energy beta particle aur antineutrino (ya neutrino) mein har baar mukhtalif hisson mein bant-ti hai, is liye beta particle ki energy is range mein kuch bhi ho sakti hai. Kham ka aakhri sira woh zyada se zyada energy hai jo beta particle ko tab milti hai jab neutrino ko taqreeban kuch nahi milta.

Nucleus se gamma radiation ka ikhraaj X* (A, Z) -> X (A, Z) + gamma radiation se zahir hota hai, jahan X* bhara hua (excited) nucleus aur X nucleus ki zameeni (ground) halat hai; A aur Z nahi badalte.

blocks.prompt: Ghaib zarra ya nucleus bhariye: (a) calcium-45 (Z = 20) -> ? + e- + nu-bar; (b) excited copper-58 (Z = 29) -> ? + gamma (short question 12.4). Uranium-238 alpha emitter aur polonium-218 (Z = 84) beta-minus emitter hai; daughters nikalein (numerical 12.1, 12.2).
blocks.explanation: (a) Beta-minus decay Z ek barhata aur A rakhta hai: scandium-45 (Z = 21). (b) Gamma decay kuch nahi badalta: zameeni halat mein copper-58 (Z = 29). Uranium-238 (Z = 92) 4 nucleons aur 2 protons khota hai: A = 234, Z = 90, thorium-234. Polonium-218 ek proton pata hai: A = 218, Z = 85, astatine-218.

blocks.prompt: Beta decay ka energy spectrum musalsal aur alpha decay ka alag alag kyun hai (short question 12.11; constructed response 12.1)? Positron ikhraaj mein neutrino ka nikalna kyun zaroori hai (short question 12.5)?
blocks.explanation: Alpha decay mein azaad energy sirf do jism baant-te hain, alpha particle aur daughter nucleus, to momentum ki baqa har ek ka hissa tay kar deti hai aur har alpha ki energy ek hoti hai. Beta decay mein teen jism baant-te hain, electron (ya positron), antineutrino (ya neutrino) aur daughter nucleus, aur taqseem har decay mein badalti hai, to beta particle sifar se zyada se zyada tak koi bhi energy rakh sakta hai. Neutrino ke baghair positron ikhraaj mein energy, momentum aur angular momentum (spin) barabar nahi hote; neutrino ghaib energy aur spin le jata hai aur lepton number baqi rakhta hai.

items: Qudrati radioactivity: Z 82 se zyada wale nuclei alpha, beta aur gamma kharij karte hain; masnoowi radioactivity radioisotopes banati hai. Electric field mein alpha - plate ki taraf thora, beta + plate ki taraf zyada murta, gamma bilkul nahi.

Alpha: Z - 2, A - 4 (radium-226 -> radon-222 + helium-4); transmutation; Q-value. Beta-minus: n -> p + e- + nu-bar, Z + 1. Beta-plus: p -> n + e+ + nu, Z - 1 (neon-19 -> fluorine-19). Gamma: X* -> X + gamma. Alpha energies alag alag, beta musalsal. Table 12.2 teeno ka muwazna.
